consumerContract.existingReport: GET /api/chief/reports/{id} 继续返回原始不可变报告；原提交 API 不变。
consumerContract.actionRequest: 以下 POST JSON 仅接受 {sessionId:string}；同机来源。未知字段（包括 body、收件人）返回 400。
consumerContract.receive: POST /api/chief/reports/{id}/receive -> {received:true, process:boolean, receipt:Receipt, report:Report, guidance:string}。仅当前 registered chief；首次持久认领 process=true，其余 false。process=false 禁止重复自动处理／呈现。
consumerContract.resend: POST /api/chief/reports/{id}/resend -> {saved:true, report:Report, received:boolean, receipt:Receipt|null, notification, diagnostic, guidance}。仅真实原发送 Chat；不接受修改正文，不新增报告。已接收返回 not-attempted，不再通知；否则只尝试当前 chief。
consumerContract.view: POST /api/chief/reports/{id}/view -> {report:Report, received:boolean, receipt:Receipt|null, process:false, guidance:string}。仅当前 chief 的明确查看；不创建接收事实或再次通知。
consumerContract.Receipt: {reportId:string, sessionId:string, claimId:string, at:number}，at 为 Unix 毫秒；独立持久 journal *.chief-reports.receipts.jsonl。
